mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 39-degree temperatures with clear skies at the Verona Area High School. We have an exciting space station sighting tonight starting at 6:32 PM, as it travels from over Mount Horeb toward the Madison area near Home Depot, climbing about halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona has released a series of election notices regarding the Fall General Election. Additionally, residents can review upcoming development projects, including site plans for the Liberty Business Park, on the city website.
There are currently no community events scheduled in Verona for the next 30 days.
In a weekly report, on Wednesday, two juveniles were cited for riding eMotos on Ashton Drive after receiving previous warnings about operating them.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. The store is currently open and serving customers until 10:30 PM tonight.
